cohort: The study included 30 placentas from full-term deliveries without complications (controls) and 30 placentas from women with hypertensive pregnancies (cases).
finding: Histopathological changes in the placenta, including syncytial knot formation, cytotrophoblasts proliferation, proliferation of endothelial lining of capillaries, stromal fibrosis, calcification, hyalinisation of villi, and infarction, were more frequent in women with hypertensive disorders and were associated with lower neonatal birth weight.
